part.text:
Fixed `OpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator.preceding()` to start its binary search at `(sentenceStarts.length - 1) / 2`, matching `following()` and avoiding the out-of-bounds access when there are exactly two sentences.

All 9 `TestOpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator` tests pass, including `testPrecedingWithTwoSentences`.
